doctrine.summary: Wishstone is mini_ark's local asset intake and routing capability. It copies source sheets into controlled intake, generates reviewable outputs, and exports approved assets into project-native folders.
doctrine.source_policy: Do not move or rewrite source files outside C:\mini_ark unless an explicit operator-approved apply/export step says so.
doctrine.intake_policy: External source paths are copied into asset_pipeline\inbox before processing. Inbox files are staging copies and may be archived after a successful run.
doctrine.token_policy: Every incoming item either arrives with a token or receives a provisional token at reception. The source document name is primary token evidence. Routing and placement decisions are downstream of token identity.
doctrine.output_policy: Generated outputs remain inside mini_ark's natural asset folders until review or approval.
doctrine.approval_policy: Approval copies the best reviewed stage into approved/ and, when family/label are supplied, into library/. Approval is an export, not a destructive cleanup.
doctrine.quality_policy: Deconstruction is lossless. Repair, precision, treatment, review, and approval are explicit stages with manifests.
doctrine.movement_policy: No deletion, dedupe, source relocation, live-app reference update, or project-file move is automatic.

standard_flow: read source document name for project/capability token evidence
detect existing token or assign provisional token
run precision pass for icon-like assets
review job quality and likely duplicates
approve/export only when operator accepts the result

token_reception.source_name_priority: If the asset sheet or source document is named for carebloom, hexseed, moonstone, cloverstone, wishstone, or another known project/capability, treat that as intentional identity evidence before falling back to weaker inference.
token_reception.missing_token_behavior: Assign a reviewable provisional token instead of treating the item as anonymous.
